original_idea: Um espaço digital para pensamentos incompletos que você não quer organizar ainda, como folhas secas que repousam antes do vento.

parsed_output.summary: A digital repository for unfinished ideas and fleeting thoughts, letting users capture them instantly without forcing immediate organization, metaphorically like leaves waiting to be carried by the wind.
strengths: Low entry barrier – users can save thoughts instantly
Encourages creativity by removing pressure to structure
Flexible metaphor appeals to artistic users
Potential for integration with existing note‑taking tools
weaknesses: May become a procrastination dump if not managed
Needs clear privacy and data‑ownership policies
parsed_output.refined_version: Create a "Thought Garden" platform where each incomplete idea is stored as a "leaf" in a virtual garden. Users can quickly add leaves via a minimal UI (text, voice, or sketch). Leaves can be grouped into clusters (branches) later, tagged, or linked to other leaves. The garden visualizes the collection as a dynamic, searchable space, offering optional nudges to review and organize older leaves. Integration hooks allow export to note‑taking apps or markdown files, and privacy controls let users keep the garden private or share selected clusters.
next_steps: Define core MVP features: quick capture, visual garden view, tagging, and search
Design low‑fi wireframes illustrating leaf creation and garden navigation
Prototype the capture UI (web/mobile) and test latency for instant saving
Research data‑storage options that support easy export and encryption
Plan a gamified review system to encourage periodic organization
